resolvedFindings.title: Recover owned fixture after an unknown Docker-create outcome
resolvedFindings.originalProblem: A timeout or nonzero Docker client outcome before assignment of the container ID left container=None and skipped cleanup even when creation had occurred.
resolvedFindings.fixVerified: Creation-attempt tracking recovers only the exact preselected name, checks the exact run label and fails on absent/ambiguous ownership rather than claiming cleanup.
resolvedFindings.captureLimit: The initial fault control did not freeze or hash a pre-fix source snapshot. Its original logic and result are retained as historical evidence; the final controls pin the final source SHA256.

resolvedFindings.title: Remove and verify the anonymous PostgreSQL data volume
resolvedFindings.originalProblem: docker rm -f removed the container but omitted the anonymous PGDATA volume declared by the PostgreSQL17 image.
resolvedFindings.fixVerified: Cleanup verifies the single expected PGDATA mount and no binds, captures its exact volume name, runs docker rm -f -v, and requires that exact volume to be absent from a successful volume inventory.
resolvedFindings.captureLimit: Prior-run volumes were not inventoried or deleted by this reviewer; the final native cleanup receipt applies to the final run only.

scopeAssessment: The changed AC3-to-AC5 attribution is appropriate: no assignment removal occurs; this exercises publication-token reuse and custody.

The commit and rollback schedules prove refusal of the same previously consumed token after an observed native retirement-first wait. Rollback leaves pending custody; it does not demonstrate non-MVCC generation rollback recovery.

The unsafe control preserves the native guard and removes the claim, then returns the already-authorized RA/RAB rows after terminal retirement. This is a useful custody-enforcement control, not a demonstrated cross-resource authorization bypass.
Synchronous fetch completion is explicitly distinguished from final consumer/transport release. Live Python result references do not establish complete host-custody drain.
No L03, full backend, graph/Delta, authenticated issuer service, public pg-runtime decoder, complete writer closure, arbitrary snapshot schedule, or general recovery claim follows.
Broader evidence-audit status is outside this review; no repository-wide green-suite claim is made.
undo: Remove the new probe and component evidence/documentation additions; the probe installs only into its disposable owned fixture and does not change the original SQL fixtures or production implementation.
